items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: one of the major influences in my life was Sam Scamacca, my high school

ctx.x: Did you have trouble getting up in the morning?

Once in a while. She threw water on me a couple of times. She actually did that a couple of times. “You’ve got to get up, you’ve got to go to school.” So then I got a pact with, again, one of the major influences in my life was Sam Scamacca, my high school.
